rules.R_align: agree = EXACT or ALIGN (= END_MAJ; must reproduce d = 0.537)
rules.R_name: agree = EXACT or NAME_ONLY or ALIGN
rules.R_liberal: R_name plus every VOCAB pair (LOWER bound on reachable d)
rules.R_point_MC: R_name plus each VOCAB pair accepted with probability 1 - 0.38764044943820225 = 0.612; 500 Monte-Carlo draws (seed 0); mean and 2.5-97.5 band combined with the bootstrap
rules.R_point_label (PRIMARY point prediction;: R_name plus VOCAB pairs only where the peer is labelled CORRECT (CORRECT candidates) or both rows are ERROR with the same error_ops class (ERROR candidates); unlabelled peers accepted with probability 0.612 (MC as above)
rules.R_oracle (no-anchoring floor): a CORRECT candidate is endorsed iff > half of its family-disjoint peers are labelled CORRECT in R_AB; unlabelled / CONTESTED / reading_choice peers count as non-agreeing; variant drops them from the denominator; ERROR candidates: endorsed iff > half of peers are ERROR in the same error_ops class (descriptive)
